description: Get the merged entry for one or more IDs: CVE, GitHub advisory (GHSA), EUVD, or an OSV ID such as PYSEC, GO or RUSTSEC. Returns the description, CVSS, CISA KEV status, EPSS, public exploits, affected packages, fixed versions, priority and source links.

id.description: One ID, such as CVE-2021-44228, GHSA-jfh8-c2jp-5v3q or PYSEC-2021-19.

ids.description: Up to 20 IDs at once, for triaging scanner output.

name: get_vulnerability

vulnerabilities.description: The entries found, in the order asked.

vulnerability.description: The entry, when one ID was asked for.

title: Look up vulnerabilities
